name: Himoto Ran
source:
A second-year student at Meirin Academy. Self-proclaimed rival of Suzune.
Her parents are certified public accountants.
Her family is fairly well-off. She has a kind side and is easily deceived.
She has attended a karate dojo since she was young and is quite skilled.

She considers Suzune her rival.
Her parents wanted her to go to a different school, but she persuaded them to let her go to Meirin Academy so she could attend the same school as Suzune. She was drawn to her by Akina and joined the handicraft club with Suzune.

Since she is often with Suzune, she challenges her to a challenge whenever she gets the chance, but Suzune has always refused.
Her academic ability is almost the same as Suzune's.
She left her parents' home after enrolling in Meirin Academy and lives alone in an apartment. She is not very good at housework, and although she tries her best, she often makes mistakes.

Her favorite thing is shonen manga (she hides this from everyone). She likes the traditional approach of hard work, friendship, and victory, which is why she became obsessed with karate.
